Three of today's biggest India stories, Mon 26 Oct:

Rahul Gandhi acquitted in the 2018 defamation case over remarks against Amit Shah. The special MP/MLA court in Sultanpur dismissed it.
Supreme Court assures no voter deleted in the Maharashtra voter list revision (SIR) will be prosecuted for applying again with Form 6. It will hear the plea on Thu 5 Nov.
Former DMK minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi arrested in the ₹100-crore (1 billion) private schools fraud case, hours after the Madras High Court dismissed his bail plea.
